analyst_view.overall: Sporting (10th, 9 points) host Manchester United (17th, 6 points); a win would put Sporting close to the top eight, while United need points to stay in the play-off spots. Both have new coaches: Paulo Fonseca at Sporting, and Mauricio Pochettino at United, whose first game was a 4-0 defeat at Liverpool on Sunday. United are without Matheus Cunha (one-match UEFA ban for his red card against Roma) and Marcus Rashford (hip), neither of whom the numbers list, plus Šeško, Baleba and Ugarte (counted); Shaw is a doubt, and Yoro is available because his ban is domestic only. Sporting miss Debast and Nuno Santos but have Ioannidis and Flávio Gonçalves back in training. Polish referee Szymon Marciniak (3.5 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals and already take Šeško off United (-4.5%). Cunha is banned and Rashford is out with a hip problem, two of United's main attackers that the numbers don't know about, so I take about 7% off, to about 2.7. United's leaky defence (19 conceded in 6) is already in the numbers, and Sporting getting Ioannidis back keeps me from going further.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners, with United slightly more of them. Fonseca's Sporting build through the middle and Pochettino has had only days to change anything, so I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, already lowered about 9% for referee Marciniak's low card count and 11% for Sporting's quiet recent record, and raised 4% for United's busy one. Cunha's ban removes one hot-headed player, but that is small, so I stay at 3.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.7 shots, with United's recent shot volume adding about 9% to their side. Without Cunha and Rashford, two of their busiest shooters, and with Šeško out, United's attack rests on Mbeumo, Fernandes and Zirkzee, so I trim a little, to about 27.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target, split evenly. Cunha's ban and Rashford's injury, which the numbers don't see, take away two of United's main finishers, so I trim slightly, to about 10.
